Cheapest 4 GB VPS

Answer: As of 2026-10-31, among 10 orderable verified 4 GB RAM plans at 2 TB egress with backups, the cheapest true monthly cost is OVHcloud VPS-1 at $5.35/mo. The priciest in this slice is Hetzner CPX21 (US) at $43.62/mo — a gap of $459/yr. Hetzner CX23 ($8.04/mo, EU only) is sold out on the provider’s page (checked 2026-10-31) and not ranked.
